easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Tinder Wall dies, Yedora triggers, returning Tinder Wall from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Tinder Wall enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Tinder Wall by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Tinder Wall face-up.
Repeat.
